description: Impact pile driving must not occur January 1 through April 30
context_quote: Impact pile driving must not occur January 1 through April 30.

description: Monopiles must be no larger than 11 m in diameter
context_quote: Monopiles must be no larger than 11 m in diameter, representing the larger end of the monopile design.

description: Hammer energies must not exceed 4,000 kilojoules for monopile installation
context_quote: Hammer energies must not exceed 4,000 kilojoules for monopile installation.

description: No more than two monopiles may be installed per day
context_quote: No more than two monopiles may be installed per day.

description: Pin piles must be no larger than 5 m in diameter
context_quote: Pin piles must be no larger than 5 m in diameter.

description: Hammer energies must not exceed 2,500 kJ for pin pile installation
context_quote: Hammer energies must not exceed 2,500 kJ for pin pile installation.

description: No more than three pin piles may be installed per day
context_quote: No more than three pin piles may be installed per day.

description: Installation and removal of cofferdams and goal posts must not occur during nighttime hours
context_quote: Installation and removal of cofferdams and goal posts must not occur during nighttime hours (defined as the hours between 1.5 hours prior to civil sunset and 1 hour after civil sunrise).

description: Installation and removal of sheet piles for cofferdams must only occur for up to 12 hours for each cofferdam
context_quote: All installation and removal of sheet piles for cofferdams and casing pipes for goal posts must only occur for up to 12 hours for each cofferdam and up to 1 hour daily for each goal post (within a single 24-hour period).

description: LOA Holder may detonate a maximum of 10 UXO/MECs
context_quote: LOA Holder may detonate a maximum of 10 UXO/MECs, of varying sizes but no larger than 1,000 pounds (lbs; 454 kilograms (kg)) charge weight (i.e., E12), over the effective period of this rulemaking and LOA.
component_name: Unexploded Ordnances or Munitions and Explosives of Concern

description: UXO/MEC detonations must not occur from November 1 through April 31, annually
context_quote: LOA Holder must not detonate UXO/MECs from November 1 through April 31, annually.
component_name: Unexploded Ordnances or Munitions and Explosives of Concern

description: No more than one detonation may occur within a 24-hour period
context_quote: No more than one detonation may occur within a 24-hour period.
component_name: Unexploded Ordnances or Munitions and Explosives of Concern

description: Sub-bottom profilers must be deactivated when not acquiring data or preparing to acquire data
context_quote: SBPs (hereinafter referred to as “acoustic sources”) must be deactivated when not acquiring data or preparing to acquire data, except as necessary for testing.

description: Acoustic sources must be used at the lowest practicable source level to meet the survey objective
context_quote: Acoustic sources must be used at the lowest practicable source level to meet the survey objective, when in use, and must be turned off when they are not necessary for the survey.
